{{Quote|It's never gonna run.|Melee, referring to [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's Podracer]]|<ref name="tpm" />}}
'''Melee''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] who found herself in the service of [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Elder]] and [[Bryyn Woolery]] on the remote desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. She was a particularly adept [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]], and her skills were tapped by both her masters. Growing up on the harsh streets of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], Melee aspired and clamored for a life of freedom, but she covered her feelings with a tough and cruel demeanor. Teaming up with [[Seek/Legends|Seek]], another young slave, she became one of the resident bullies of [[Slave Quarters Row/Legends|Slave Quarters Row]], crushing the hopes of other slaves with stinging remarks. At an early age, she found herself attracted to fellow slave [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], but she kept her feelings hidden and was devastated when he was later freed.

When Gardulla was fed to her own [[Gardulla's krayt dragon|canyon krayt dragon]], Melee fell into the hands of [[Bryyn Woolery]], a machinery [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]]. Though Skywalker had left Tatooine, Melee still visited his [[Parent/Legends|mother]], [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi]]. She and her [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], taught Melee to read and write. Woolery eventually moved to the more lucrative [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], where business was strong enough to allow him to free Melee. Melee remained in Woolery's employ, however, putting her mechanical skills to good use.

==Biography==
===In the service of Gardulla the Elder===
Melee was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|girl]] who was a [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Having been [[Currency/Legends|sold]] as property since her earliest recollections, she knew nothing of her origins and was<ref name="db" /> one of many<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|304|Melee}}</ref> [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by<ref name="db" /> the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Gardulla">{{DB|character|gardullathehutt|Gardulla the Hutt}}</ref> [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]]. First keeping the girl as a cleaner, Gardulla took note of her hands, tiny and useful in fixing machinery. She then became skilled in the mechanics of [[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]].<ref name="db" /> Secretly, the girl had dreams of adventures among the [[Star/Legends|stars]], though the harshness of the world<ref name="db" /> she grew up on<ref name="CSWE" /> forced her to keep them to herself and she adopted a tough attitude. She befriended [[Seek/Legends|Seek]], the local bully of [[Slave Quarters Row/Legends|Slave Quarters Row]] in the<ref name="db" /> [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="MosEspa">{{DB|location|mosespa|Mos Espa}}</ref> [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], and the two formed a pair that teased the children who dared to dream of a better life,<ref name="db" /> even though Seek had dreams of his own.<ref name="Journal">''[[Star Wars Journal: Anakin Skywalker]]''</ref> Melee secretly adored<ref name="CSWE" /> the enslaved boy [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and her insults to him were a cover for her deeply felt, yet inarticulate feelings.<ref name="db" />

[[File:AnakinAndFriends-TPM.png|thumb|right|300px|Melee and her friends viewed Skywalker's podracer.]]
On the eve of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], in which Skywalker would be competing, Melee joined Seek and several friends to inspect his self-built racer. However, she eschewed helping him in favor of playing ball with Seek. When the day of the race came, she sneaked away from Seek's presence and entered the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] grandstand to watch the race. She was elated when Skywalker finished first, but she was soon met with the news that a [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|tall outlander]] had spirited him away to a better life. Though she was bitterly disappointed, Melee found solace in the fact that he had been freed and was moving onto better things. Seek, however, thought that fortune would not smile on the Mos Espa slaves twice.<ref name="db" />

===In the service of Bryyn Woolery===
When Gardulla was later fed to her own [[Gardulla's krayt dragon|canyon krayt dragon]] by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] in 32 BBY,<ref name="bh">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> Melee fell into the service of [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Bryyn Woolery]]. She also visited Anakin's [[Parent/Legends|mother]], [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]], from time to time, who taught her to read and write with the help of the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]. Melee continued to reside in the Slave Quarters until Woolery moved to the larger [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] in pursuit of more lucrative fare. As a result, Melee fell out of touch with the elder Skywalker. In Mos Eisley, Woolery turned enough of a profit to free Melee, but the young woman decided to stay in her former master's employ as an errand girl.<ref name="db" />

===Freedom===
Using a dilapidated old [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]], Melee would make deliveries to remote settlements around Mos Eisley. Many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] passed, and in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], upon delivering a shipment to [[Tosche Station/Legends|Tosche Station]] outside the town of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], she heard word of a [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and decided to inquire, thinking she may have found Anakin, the subject of her affections. Traveling to Skywalker's home, the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]], she was met with nothing but the smoldering remains of the [[Lars family/Legends|Lars']] [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farm]]. She never discovered that this Skywalker was in fact the son of Anakin, her old friend.<ref name="db" />

In the following years, Melee enlisted the services of a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], hoping to have a gang of [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] outside Mos Eisley eliminated.<ref name="swg">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Melee's Drama}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Born a slave, Melee was an ambitious person, with dreams and aspirations that looked far beyond her post. Since such thoughts were often frowned upon or scorned by other slaves, she kept her intentions and ideas private, veiling them with a harsh and mean-spirited demeanor. Her attraction to fellow slave Anakin Skywalker was also kept secret, as she felt it would test her friendship with Seek. In reality, she did in fact doubt his mechanical skills, as she was experienced in that particular field. In her later life, Melee stayed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], despite being freed, and was relatively ignorant of developments in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as a whole.<ref name="db" />

==Skills and abilities==
Skilled in the mechanics of Podracers, Melee was able to identify most parts of the vehicles' engines and cockpits, even customized ones. She saw them as not being more complicated than a children's puzzle.<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Melee first appeared in [[George Lucas]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], wherein she was portrayed by [[Megan Udall]]. The character's backstory was later developed by "[[Alex Dishal|jarjarsmeagol]]," "[[Ghent the Slicer|Ghent&#95;the&#95;Slicer]]," "[[Cockroach King FS]]," and "[[James Floyd|jawajames1]]" through the [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature ''[[What's The Story?]]'' The information from the resulting [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry was later used in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="db" /> Although Melee's Databank entry states Gardulla the Elder was killed by Jango Fett during the events of [[2002]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]], the [[2010]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode "[[Hunt for Ziro]]" revealed that the Hutt had in fact survived the incident.
